leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: Which leagues to compare. La Liga, Bundesliga, MLS, Champions League and UFC currently come from Pinnacle only.

books.title: Sportsbooks
books.description: Which books to compare. Best prices and arbitrage need at least two.

dateFrom.title: From date (UTC)
dateFrom.description: Only games starting on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for everything the books have listed.

dateTo.title: To date (UTC)
dateTo.description: Only games starting on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

includeSummary.title: Best price, fair odds and arbitrage
includeSummary.description: Add one summary row per game and market: the best price per outcome across books, no-vig fair probabilities, and an arbitrage flag with its margin.

arbitrageOnly.title: Arbitrage opportunities only
arbitrageOnly.description: Return only summary rows where an arbitrage exists across the selected books.

mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Monitor: only lines that moved since the last run
mode.description: Monitor mode remembers the previous run's lines and returns only what changed, with the old price and the move in probability points. Schedule it to track line movement.

monitorStoreName.title: Monitor memory name
monitorStoreName.description: Name of the key-value store that holds the last snapshot. Use a different name for each separate monitor you schedule.

maxEvents.title: Max games
maxEvents.description: Stop after this many games, soonest first.
